paragraphs.text: Riverside Observatory opens to visitors from Wednesday to Sunday. The dome is open from 10 am, and evening viewing sessions start at 8 pm between October and March. Tickets cost £9 for adults and £5 for anyone under 16.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The main telescope was installed in 1974 and has a mirror 1.2 metres across. Groups of more than ten people must book at least two weeks in advance by email. Photography is allowed everywhere except in the control room.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: On which day of the week is the observatory closed first?
How much does a ticket cost for a child of 12?
How wide is the mirror of the main telescope?

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Find the answer in the text. You have 20 seconds for each question. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.
